SELECT COALESCE(source_id, '(unclassified)') AS source_id, COUNT(*)::int AS document_count, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(updated_at)))::bigint AS lag FROM documents WHERE documents.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT documents.archived GROUP BY COALESCE(source_id, '(unclassified)')

SELECT COALESCE(d.source_id, '(unclassified)') AS source_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id)::int AS chunk_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FILTER ( WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT d.archived AND COALESCE(d.frontmatter->>'kind','') <> 'code' AND NOT (COALESCE(d.frontmatter, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'embed_skip') AND length(btrim(c.content)) > 0 )::int AS embeddable, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FILTER ( WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT d.archived AND COALESCE(d.frontmatter->>'kind','') <> 'code' AND NOT (COALESCE(d.frontmatter, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'embed_skip') AND length(btrim(c.content)) > 0 AND em.chunk_id IS NOT NULL )::int AS embedded, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(d.frontmatter->>'kind','') = 'code')::int AS code FROM chunks c JOIN documents d ON d.id = c.document_id LEFT JOIN embeddings em ON em.chunk_id = c.id WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT d.archived GROUP BY COALESCE(d.source_id, '(unclassified)')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FILTER ( WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT d.archived AND COALESCE(d.frontmatter->>'kind','') <> 'code' AND NOT (COALESCE(d.frontmatter, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'embed_skip') AND length(btrim(c.content)) > 0 )::int AS embeddable, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FILTER ( WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT d.archived AND COALESCE(d.frontmatter->>'kind','') <> 'code' AND NOT (COALESCE(d.frontmatter, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'embed_skip') AND length(btrim(c.content)) > 0 AND em.chunk_id IS NOT NULL )::int AS embedded, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(d.frontmatter->>'kind','') = 'code')::int AS code FROM chunks c JOIN documents d ON d.id = c.document_id LEFT JOIN embeddings em ON em.chunk_id = c.id WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT d.archived
SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(updated_at)))::bigint AS lag FROM documents d WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT d.archived

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'pending')::int AS queue_depth, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE status = 'failed' AND (finished_at IS NULL OR finished_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') )::int AS failed_24h FROM jobs
SELECT source_id FROM pages WHERE source_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT source_id FROM entity_facts WHERE source_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT (te.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date::text AS date, te.event AS summary, te.detail, te.slug, te.event_slug, ep.compiled_truth->'event'->>'kind' AS kind FROM timeline_events te JOIN pages p ON p.slug = te.slug AND p.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN pages ep ON ep.slug = te.event_slug WHERE (te.event_slug IS NULL OR ep.deleted_at IS NULL) AND (te.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date = $1::date AND te.source_id = ANY($2::text[]) AND p.source_id = te.source_id AND (te.event_slug IS NULL OR ep.source_id = te.source_id) ORDER BY te.occurred_at ASC, te.id ASC LIMIT $3
SELECT source_id FROM pages WHERE source_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT source_id FROM entity_facts WHERE source_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT (te.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date::text AS date, te.event AS summary, te.detail, te.slug, te.event_slug, ep.compiled_truth->'event'->>'kind' AS kind FROM timeline_events te JOIN pages p ON p.slug = te.slug AND p.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN pages ep ON ep.slug = te.event_slug WHERE (te.event_slug IS NULL OR ep.deleted_at IS NULL) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM (te.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM $1::date) AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM (te.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')) = EXTRACT(DAY FROM $1::date) AND (te.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date < $1::date AND te.source_id = ANY($2::text[]) AND p.source_id = te.source_id AND (te.event_slug IS NULL OR ep.source_id = te.source_id) ORDER BY te.occurred_at DESC, te.id ASC LIMIT $3
SELECT source_id FROM pages WHERE source_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT source_id FROM entity_facts WHERE source_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT ON (dimension) dimension, value, confidence, source_slug, valid_from::text AS valid_from, valid_until::text AS valid_to, COALESCE(dim_status, 'active') AS status, id AS fact_id FROM entity_facts WHERE entity_slug = $1 AND dimension IS NOT NULL AND forgotten_at IS NULL AND source_id = ANY($2::text[]) AND COALESCE(valid_from, '-infinity'::date) <= COALESCE($3::date, CURRENT_DATE) AND COALESCE(valid_until, 'infinity'::date) > COALESCE($3::date, CURRENT_DATE) AND confidence >= $4 AND ($5::boolean OR dim_status IS NULL OR dim_status = 'active') AND ($6::boolean = false OR visibility = 'world') ORDER BY dimension, valid_from DESC NULLS LAST, confidence DESC, id DESC
